title: Slow to Anger, Great in Kindness
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler who brings the broken pieces out in both hands, and tonight Joel asks a whole people to do the same: stop hiding, turn back with the whole heart, and trust that kindness, not temper, is waiting. Telling the truth about the clay bird is exactly Beau’s kind of brave.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because telling the truth takes real courage. In Beau’s world today: Beau broke the little clay bird off the shelf and hid the pieces under a cushion. His tummy hurt all afternoon. At bath time he brought the pieces out in both hands and told Mom everything. Just like the people Joel asked to turn back with all their heart, Beau learned that turning back is safe when love is waiting.
